findings.claim: Apple 占 2025 年淨銷售 29.8%、Qualcomm 11.1%，前十大客戶合計 72%；IDM 客戶會拿 Amkor 服務與自家 in-house 能力比較。
findings.excerpt: Our ten largest customers accounted for 72% of our net sales in 2025. Direct sales to Apple and Qualcomm accounted for 29.8% and 11.1% of our net sales, respectively, for the year ended December 31, 2025.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素載明 IDM 與晶圓代工客戶可能隨時把外包封測轉回自有產能。
findings.excerpt: IDMs and foundries may decide to shift some or all of their outsourced packaging and test services to internally sourced capacity.

note: 搜尋 1 次未找到 2026 年最大客戶（Apple/Qualcomm）導入第二供應商或自製 Amkor 該環節的具體報導；僅 10-K 通用風險揭露。
